notes: Smarter, more honest mode detection. Sonar no longer assumes a browser means video — on YouTube (which is just as often music or a lecture) it now says so plainly and lets you pick, instead of guessing wrong. It still confidently spots calls (mic in use) and real video players (QuickTime, VLC, Netflix, etc.). Defaults to Music when unsure, so nothing drops out. Update both Macs.
